additional_info.subject: ID0437363-DC/Null/DE-[SF2R6455143]Loading not possible internal error CRM:02681000485
additional_info.body:
Hello Björn, good afternoon.
I checked the logs for this charger for the past 7 days and here are my findings:
There were 84 successfull charging sessions in all outlets:
DC1 - 21
DC2 - 33
DC3 - 13
DC4 - 17
The most common error is the 37/38/39 which all relate to failed authentications:
This means that the customer didn't present the RFID or QR code to start the charging process.
Throught all the sessions, I only see one failed session which is really a bug from our side due to the FW being outdated:
This error relates to a communication timeout that we can resolve by updating to the latest FW version.
​​​​​​​​​​​​​​From my side, everything is explained, the failure rate is due to the customers not using the Authentication properly.
If you want me to update the charger to the latest version in order to mitigate the Error 69, let me know and I can do it.
Looking forward to your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
